title: Hot Wheels Stunt Track Challenge
summary: Hot Wheels Stunt Track Challenge is a 2004 PlayStation 2 and Game Boy Advance video game of the Hot Wheels franchise. The console versions are well known for stealing game mechanics, sounds, and vehicle models from Hot Wheels: World Race. The announcer sounds a lot like Vert Wheeler, however it is unknown if the voice actor for Vert voiced the announcer.

title: Attack Pack
summary: 200px|rightAttack Pack was a line of monstrous trucks and vehicles designed by Mike McKittrick and others released from 1992 to 1994. The main gimmick of these vehicles was their transforming action when they were pressed down, causing them to open their mouths or perform other actions. They were even available as McDonalds Happy Meal toys, as an option to Barbie dolls.
